qualification: binary package build and APT transaction simulation only; no host installation, unit suites or runtime/display acceptance

compiler.environment: disposable agent container; dependencies from the distribution archive; nothing installed on the laptop host
compiler.warning_policy: Debian packaging defaults; not a warnings-as-errors build (the source candidates were compiled with warnings as errors during qualification)
compiler.quilt_state: imported trees are the quilt-applied state; .pc/applied-patches regenerated from debian/patches/series so dpkg-source does not reapply

artifact_sets.build_options: nocheck parallel=2; cross-built with dpkg-buildpackage -a i386 -B

artifact_sets.subproject_note: subprojects/gvdb ships in the pinned mutter_51.0.orig.tar.xz (sha256 5d28f3ae…d983b3, verified) but upstream .gitignore keeps it out of the Git import; it was extracted from that tarball

candidate_simulation.method: apt-get -s install of the six local packages on the laptop, as an unprivileged user

rollback_model_simulation.method: private copy of the installed dpkg status with only the six candidate control records substituted; apt-get -s install of the retained hdr6/nativehdr2 packages
rollback_model_simulation.limitation: modeled rollback; the host package database was not changed

transaction_summary.rollback_artifacts: the six previously installed packages are retained privately on the laptop and their recorded hashes verified
session: Log out of GNOME before replacement; restart the display manager so a new GNOME Shell loads the new library
Keep a text-console or SSH recovery route
No kernel, Secure Boot, bootloader, ICC profile, display mode or saved setting change

scope: hdr8 library and nativehdr5 compositor (PR 6). Later compositor batches are not covered.
